```{r setup, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#Add libraries here
library(tidyverse)
library(pastecs)

# Load Data
dat <- read.csv('TextMessages.csv')
str(dat)
## The dataset has 4 variables, all classed as integers. 
## It appears that the the variable "Group" is a factor so this will need to be
## updated.
## There is a variable (Participant) indexing the participants
## The other two variables (Baseline, Six_months) are scores taken for each
## participant at different time periods.

## ---- Factorize variables ----

dat$Participant <- as.factor(dat$Participant)
dat$Group <- as.factor(dat$Group)

## ---- Transform data ----
# For ease of visualization, we transform the data to a long format

dat.long <- dat %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Baseline, Six_months),
    names_to = 'Time',
    values_to = 'TextMessages'
  )
```

# Stratified Boxplot

```{r boxplot, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# We want to make a boxplots stratified by both Group and Time

ggplot(dat.long, aes(Time, TextMessages)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = 'black', fill = 'lightgrey') +
  # geom_jitter(color = 'blue', width = 0.2) +
  theme_light() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(dat.long$TextMessages))) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(dat.long$TextMessages)*1.2, by = 10)) +
  labs(
    title = 'Boxplots of Text Messages',
    subtitle = 'Stratified by Group and Time-Period',
    x = 'Group',
    y = 'Number of Messages'
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Group)+
  NULL

```

At baseline, the two groups appear normally distributed and are very similar to each other, with a median around 65. At 6 months, both groups had a decrease in messages; Group 1 appears to have had more of a decrease, and has several outliers that are very low.

# Stratified Bar Chart

```{r bar, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
ggplot(dat.long, aes(x=Time, y=TextMessages, fill=Time)) +
  facet_wrap(~Group) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "RdPu") +
  labs(title = "Average # of Text Messages by Group and Time",
       x = "Time", y = "Average # of Text Messages") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
